name: Lyra, Archangel of Dawn
description: The leader of the Order of Dawn who led the Benalish defense against the Phyrexians and was knighted by Danitha Capashen.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Lyra receives an honorary knighthood from Danitha Capashen to further ties between the Serrans and Benalia.
timeline.quote: Lyra received an honorary knighthood from Danitha Capashen meant to further the ties between the Serrans and Benalia.
